title: Open BPMN Exercise Corpus: 36 BPMN 2.0 exercises, entry assessment and exams with sample solutions (German and English)
description: 36 BPMN 2.0 modelling exercises in German and English, organised by six topics (activities, gateways, events, collaboration, data, exceptions) and two levels (basic, advanced). Each exercise has a task text, a learning goal, typical mistakes and a sample solution as BPMN 2.0 XML with diagram and SVG. Sample solutions follow a written modelling guideline based on the Seven Process Modeling Guidelines, Silver's BPMN Method and Style and eCH-0158, and are checked automatically. Includes an entry assessment (14 multiple-choice items and a modelling task with rubric), PDF exercise booklets, and a Basic and an Advanced exam (60 minutes, 40 points) whose four questions each come in five equivalent variants for rotation, with sample solutions, rubrics and PDF exam and solution sheets.
